meta.name: cull
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to view, review, rate, organize, search, or export images / AI-art generations with the Cull app. Trigger on "show me these images", "review this batch", "open these in Cull", "rate / shortlist / collect these", "find similar images", "make a smart collection", "run a quality pass", "export the keepers", "publish this collection". Works via the `cull` CLI by default (no MCP required); the `mcp__cull__*` tools are optional for richer interactive control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浏览、评级和整理你的 AI 生成图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常生成大量 AI 图片需要分类和评分
copy.tagline_en: Browse, rate, and organize your AI-generated images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently generate batches of AI images and need to sort and rate them

howto.what: Claude会将图像查看、评分、搜索等操作交给Cull应用处理，通过命令行和URL方案导入文件夹、浏览、评分、查找相似、导出等，不再使用系统预览工具。
howto.when: 当你提到“展示这些图片”、“审阅这批”、“在Cull中打开”等关键词，或要求进行图像评分、搜索、导出等操作时触发。

say.text: 找出与这张图相似的图片

howto.what_en: Claude delegates image viewing, rating, searching, and exporting to the Cull app via CLI and URL scheme, avoiding system Preview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'show me these images', 'review this batch', 'open these in Cull', or similar image operations.
